retryRules: Every retry of one intent reuses the same deterministic idempotency key.
The same key with a different actor, amount, currency, destination or revision is a conflict.
Timeout, reload and lost response require reconciliation or replay with the same key.
A succeeded intent always returns the same stored withdrawal identifier.
A terminal rejection cannot be converted into a new withdrawal by changing the key silently.
A new intent requires an explicit user action after the previous intent is resolved.
dataBoundary: Only an opaque destination reference and SHA-256 fingerprint are allowed.
Raw account holder, document, branch, account number, Pix key and bank snapshot are forbidden.
The contract never stores provider credentials or bank secrets.
runtimeIntegrationRequirements: Persist the withdrawal intent before the first network request.
Reuse the exact intent and idempotency key after reload, timeout or response loss.
Bind the server ledger to actor, route and request fingerprint.
Return the stored withdrawal for successful replays.
Reject the same key with a different payload.
Expose a reconciliation path for claimed or unknown-after-submit intents.
Do not mark a withdrawal completed before provider confirmation and reconciliation.
Obtain explicit authorization before runtime, migration, staging or deployment changes.
